# Merriweather (Black 900, the Latin subset)

The serif of Form TV-1's Chapters look (the chapter bar and the ticker). Merriweather is by the Merriweather Project Authors
(Eben Sorkin), licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1 (`LICENSE`). The file is the Latin subset as published by Fontsource
(`@fontsource/merriweather` 5.3.0, `files/merriweather-latin-900-normal.woff2`), unchanged. `tools/forms/TV-1/build.sh` puts it
into the form as an `@font-face` rule (a data URL), with Lato, so the cards need no network.
